description: Search places and retrieve geographic entities. Use lookup for local address, business, brand and landmark search with soft map-focus bias, strict house numbers, source IDs and ambiguity reporting. Use discover for POIs in a viewport, polygon or isochrone, optionally ranked by travel time. Other operations: search, autocomplete, nearby, reverse, details, geocode, resolve, entity. Requires a subscription key.

bbox.description: west,south,east,north. lookup: soft focus unless bounded is true. discover: required region boundary unless region or minutes is supplied.

bounded.description: lookup: explicitly restrict results to bbox.

category.description: lookup/discover: business or POI category, such as coffee, pharmacy or restaurants. nearby: feature category, such as cafe, restaurant, hospital or park.

entityId.description: entity only: an id from resolve, beginning geo_.

minutes.description: discover: generate an isochrone from lat/lon.

operation.description: lookup: local address, business and brand suggestions with soft map-focus bias. discover: businesses in a viewport, polygon or isochrone, optionally ranked by travel time. resolve: name to entity ID. entity: entity lookup. search: populated-place names. autocomplete: populated-place prefixes. nearby: radius search. reverse: coordinate lookup. details: OSM type and ID lookup. geocode: compatibility provider; use lookup for new integrations.

placeClass.description: search and autocomplete: restrict to one class of populated place.

q.description: lookup: address/name text, 1–120 characters. discover: optional name/brand filter. search/autocomplete: populated-place name. geocode: compatibility provider query.

radius.description: Metres. Defaults to 500 for nearby and 150 for reverse.

rankBy.description: discover: travel_time compares the nearest 25 candidates.

region.description: discover: polygon GeoJSON or owned result handle; alternatively supply bbox or minutes.

name: geo_search
